site.name: AngleSharp
site.title: AngleSharp — The ultimate angle brackets parser for .NET
site.description: AngleSharp is a .NET library that parses HTML5, CSS, SVG, MathML, and XML to construct a DOM based on the official W3C specifications. Standards-driven, fast, and extensible.
site.author: Florian Rappl

projects.name: AngleSharp
projects.label: Core
projects.tagline: The standards-driven HTML5 parser and DOM.
projects.description: HTML parser, DOM provider, CSS selector engine, and core utilities. Helpers and parsing for MIME types, URLs, source sets, and many more. Provides the extension points used by all other projects.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Css
projects.label: Css
projects.tagline: Full CSS parser, CSSOM, and style computation.
projects.description: A full CSS parser and CSSOM provider to include support for stylesheets, inline styles, and style computations within AngleSharp.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Js
projects.label: Js
projects.tagline: Run JavaScript against the DOM via Jint.
projects.description: Integrates a .NET-based JavaScript engine (Jint) and provides the DOM bindings, so scripts in a page can run and interact with the document.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Xml
projects.label: Xml
projects.tagline: XML and DTD parsing with DOM capabilities.
projects.description: Adds DOM capabilities to XML documents, including XHTML, SVG documents, and DTD validation.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Io
projects.label: Io
projects.description: IO modules and helpers, including improved requesters, file downloads, storage abilities, and caching mechanisms.

projects.name: AngleSharp.XPath
projects.label: XPath
projects.description: Adds the ability to select nodes via XPath queries as an alternative to CSS selector syntax.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Diffing
projects.label: Diffing
projects.tagline: Compare DOM trees and get semantic differences.
projects.description: Compares two AngleSharp node lists and yields a list of differences between them. Powers the markup verification in bUnit.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Wasm
projects.label: Wasm
projects.description: Adds support for running and interacting with WebAssembly modules from within AngleSharp browsing contexts.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Renderer
projects.label: Renderer
projects.tagline: Layout and paint the styled DOM.
projects.description: Renders the styled DOM from its render tree: layout, painting, and interactivity on top of AngleSharp.Css.

projects.name: AngleSharp.Browser
projects.label: Browser
projects.tagline: The whole ecosystem, assembled into a browser.
projects.description: Aggregates the entire AngleSharp ecosystem into a browser engine — headless or with actual interactive output.
